model.name: Seedance 2.0 Mini
model.shortDescription: Seedance 2.0 Mini by ByteDance. Budget-tier video model up to 720p, 4-15 seconds, with text, image, or multimodal references and optional native audio.

inputs.description: Describe the video you want. You can point to your uploaded files with "@" - for example, "@image1" or "@video1" - to reference them directly in your description. Optional if you provide a first frame or reference images/videos.
inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.name: prompt

inputs.description: An image to use as the video's opening frame. Can't be combined with reference images or videos.
inputs.label: First Frame
inputs.name: image

lastFrameImage.message: A first frame must be provided if a last frame is set.

inputs.description: Images to guide the video's subjects and style (up to 9). Can't be combined with a first frame.
inputs.label: Reference Images
inputs.name: referenceImages

inputs.description: Videos to guide the motion and style (up to 3). Can't be combined with a first frame.
inputs.label: Reference Videos
inputs.name: referenceVideos

inputs.description: Audio tracks to guide the video (up to 3). Requires at least one reference image or video.
inputs.label: Reference Audio
inputs.name: referenceAudio

inputs.description: How long the video lasts, in seconds (4–15). Auto matches the length of your longest reference video (kept within 4–15s).
inputs.label: Duration
inputs.name: duration

inputs.description: The output quality. Higher resolution is sharper but costs more (this model supports up to 720p).
inputs.label: Resolution
inputs.name: resolution

inputs.description: The shape of the video. Auto picks a fitting shape based on your inputs.
inputs.label: Aspect Ratio
inputs.name: aspectRatio

inputs.description: Adds a generated soundtrack to the video. On by default.
inputs.label: Generate Audio
inputs.name: generateAudio
